text: About 0.5 hectares (3.4%) of the property’s native forest was lost in 2022. The total tree-cover loss was 0.6 hectares, but only 0.5 hectares of that was confirmed as native forest (the remaining 0.1 hectare was outside mapped forest areas). The loss was detected by Hansen GFC and corroborated by JRC 2020 data, though the cause (e.g., logging, fire) and legality remain unknown. The property’s total area is 17.6 hectares.
